question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination: 

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & 1 \\ 3 & 3 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-1){R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=2 \\ \,\,\,\,-3{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=1 \\ \,\,-2{x}_{3}=-5 \\ \,\,0=-4,\end{aligned}
$$

 

where the fourth equation is always false. Therefore, the system has no solution and we conclude that 

$$
x\notin \text{Span}\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\}.
$$
